Sreenivas L
Bala Upadhyayula
Key Takeaways
The meeting focused on integrating AI-driven tools to enhance learning experiences at coaching centers and discussed developing a proof of concept (POC) for SAP training.
Bharath MVS and Harsha Thota from Thinkbyte.ai collaborated with Bala Upadhyayula to explore AI solutions for educational institutions.
Key issues included improving student engagement through personalized learning, addressing faculty challenges, and aligning training with job requirements.
Action items included creating use cases for a POC, involving stakeholders for feedback, and planning a demo session for potential clients.
The team agreed to develop an MVP for an AI-based learning platform and conduct a POC targeting SAP education centers to validate the solution's effectiveness.
